title: Low-rate sandwiched-Renyi exponent for quantum privacy amplification
summary: Determine the exact low-rate privacy-amplification exponent for sandwiched-Renyi orders strictly between one and two.

formal_statement.body: Let $s\in(0,1]$ and let $\widetilde D_{1+s}$ denote the sandwiched-Renyi divergence used by the source. For an admissible cq source $\rho_{XE}$ and hash rate $R<R_{\mathrm{critical}}$, determine the exact optimal exponent of $$\widetilde D_{1+s}\!\left(\rho_{Z_nE^n}^{f_n}\middle\|\tau_{Z_n}\otimes\rho_E^{\otimes n}\right)$$ under the source hashing model. Establish matching bounds for every $s\in(0,1]$ and every source-admissible low rate.

scope.domain: Quantum privacy amplification under sandwiched-Renyi divergence in the low-rate regime
assumptions: $\rho_{XE}$ and the hash model follow source Theorem 5
scope.unresolved_remainder: The 2026 preprint gives an exact reliability function for sandwiched-Renyi orders $\alpha\in[2,\infty)$, settling the boundary $\alpha=2$ of the source range. The source problem remains open for every $\alpha=1+s\in(1,2)$ in the low-rate regime.

progress.summary: The source derives the exponent at and above the critical rate and explicitly leaves the complementary low-rate sandwiched-Renyi exponent open.
A later preprint proves exact quantum privacy-amplification reliability functions for sandwiched-Renyi orders at least two, including the source range's endpoint at order two.
